scope: Disposable SQLite sources from the disclosed 18-member family, supporting put/update/delete/begin/commit/rollback on main or other connections, with goals limited to channel, committed_count, or committed_sum.
lesson: The simulator must correctly model shared state across connections within transactions and reset per-statement change counters appropriately. It distinguishes between INSERT OR IGNORE, REPLACE, and UPSERT behaviors, accounts for optional AFTER INSERT triggers affecting auxiliary logs (though not directly influencing returned metrics here), and accurately computes channel values based on whether they reflect last statement changes, total main connection changes, or combined totals. Consistency checks against historical receipts filter valid configurations before predicting outcomes for new sequences.
